mutants.name: deps-skip-frozen
mutants.rule: An importer reads its imports' frozen interfaces.

mutants.name: result-by-wave-order
mutants.rule: Each package's result is its own task's, in the program's order.

mutants.name: import-index-unshifted
mutants.rule: A PkgName's import is its place in the sorted import list plus one (0 is the package itself).

mutants.name: selector-ignores-shadow
mutants.rule: A selector whose X is a local reads no import.

mutants.name: selector-unexported
mutants.rule: An XRef names an exported declaration only (C0/plan.md §4).

mutants.name: selector-unrecorded
mutants.rule: A selector into an import is a use of the import's declaration.

mutants.name: derive-selector-unrecorded
mutants.rule: A derive clause's qualified name is a use of the import's declaration.

mutants.name: join-drops-ext
mutants.rule: The join sets each body's import uses.
